_comment: Benchmark reference of the release, versioned here because workflow artifacts expire (ENF-QUAL-007); attached as bench-reference.json to every release (release.yml). Thresholds are the spec's (ENF-PERF-001, -008, -009) and are never loosened by a bench. `manifest` is what backend/tests/bench/generator.py writes for the profile (regenerate: uv run python -m tests.bench.generator --reference).
